notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve signup; small B2B SaaS startup building in-app assistant for their customer portal.

Context and priorities:
- Product: user-facing chat inside a multi-tenant SaaS dashboard (support + guided workflows). Mobile-first UX; visible typing/streaming experience matters.
- Main ask: low-latency streaming (token-by-token) + predictable p50 on mobile. Customer said: "Need chat to feel instant — streaming is non-negotiable."
- Early stage: testing hosted API first (no private infra planned right now). Prefers public cloud only.
- Cost: very cost conscious; will use hosted API but expect recommendations on batching, cache, and cheaper fallback models for long contexts.
- Security: requires SSO (SAML) for admin console; also wants audit logs for model calls. No on-prem / air-gapped requirement currently.

POC plan (proposed):
- 2-week spike using Redwood Hosted API. Goals: integrate streaming SDK in mobile app, validate p50/p95, implement prefix caching for repeated prompts, test fallback to smaller model when large model unavailable.
- Metrics: token cost per session, p50/p95 latency, stream completeness, fallback hit rate.

What we've done so far:
- Provided API keys and quickstart.
- Shared initial pricing deck and public streaming SDK snippet (drive:/decks/sparkline-redwood-pricing-v1.pdf).
- SE (Leila) triaged engineering latency report; raised caching + batching suggestions.

Quoted from product lead (Slack/slash call paraphrase): "We want the chat to feel like typing to a person — even on 4G. If it stalls or shows a long spinner the conversion drops."

Next actions (owner: Jordan / SE: Leila):
- Send targeted streaming quickstart with mobile SDK snippet by 2026-03-06.
- Offer a short runbook for p50 tuning: batching configs, smallest-acceptable model for fallback, KV cache tips.
- Confirm SAML timeline and whether they need Redwood-managed SSO or will handle via their IDP.
- Kickoff 2-week spike once SAML blocking questions cleared.

Risk / blockers:
- Unknown SAML timeline could delay rollout to staging accounts.
- Their mobile p50 goal (sub-200ms) may require edge routing or regional placement; need to discuss regional routing options and realistic expectations.
